title: hyperlane-testnet
tagline: Testnet bridge via Hyperlane on Scroll & Zircuit L2s based of Warp routes & Warp UI. Easy & accessible
description:
This allows the native transfer of ETH via Hyperlane. This allows us to transfer testnet funds on multiple networks accessibly.

We also want to allow the implementation of other networksa s much as possible. Many of testnets were also provided via Hacker Pack for brussels, and that was our main inspiration.
how_its_made:
We utilized the Warp routes via hyperlane and deployed onto several networks (zircuit testnet, sepolia, scroll sepolia, etc). We followed the documentation provided by Hyperlane.

Hyperlane provides the opportunity to deploy on many bridges accessibly, which is why it's the main implementaion of our project.
